$comment: Question templates, one per use case. Each is a Clef `questions` object: typed questions over the fields in Observation.json, with every allowed option written out so the model returns a probability per option rather than free text. Compose a request as {model, state, questions}.
$lanes: A lane is a request shape, not a request: each names the fields it sends and the templates it serves. A driving tick sends the numbers the question reads plus the sentence that says what they mean; a recovery tick sends the window's metres and the wheel state; the full state is only for the slow lane. Sending everything every tick is the thing this avoids - it costs tokens, latency and money for fields the question never reads. What it must never avoid is the sentence: a model given numbers and no description answers as if the road were empty, which is how a car ends up holding the throttle against a wall.

drive.why: the fastest lane: the numbers plus the sentence that says what they mean - five numbers and no description is what made the model answer 'throttle' at a wall

recover.cadence: only while blocked, creeping or slipping
recover.why: the escape lane: the window's metres are the evidence that the car is against something, and reversing with the wheel turned is the only way out of it

corner.why: yaw rate says how the car is actually rotating, which the cue alone cannot

race.why: the race lane adds the two fields that say a race is on at all

context.cadence: rarely - a slow lane for judgement, not control
context.why: the full state, for questions where latency does not matter

freeroam.cruise.when: free roam, no cue on screen, speed below target

action.instructions: The route cue is not visible and the car is under its target pace. What next?

criteria.throttle: Hold the line and keep the throttle down

confidence.instructions: How sure are you of that action?

freeroam.track_cue.when: a route cue is on screen

action.instructions: The route arrow is on screen at route_cue_x, where 0.0 is the far LEFT of the view, 1.0 is the far RIGHT and 0.5 is dead ahead. The road continues where the arrow points, so a value below 0.5 means the road turns LEFT and above 0.5 means it turns RIGHT. What next?

criteria.steer_left: Turn toward the left of the road
criteria.steer_right: Turn toward the right of the road
criteria.throttle: Hold the line and keep the throttle down

urgency.instructions: How urgently should this be applied?

corner.entry.when: approaching a turn, speed above the turn pace

action.instructions: A turn is coming and the car is above its cornering pace. What next?

criteria.throttle: Stay on the throttle through it

severity.instructions: How much speed should come off?

traffic.follow.when: a car in our lane, ahead, within 60 m

action.instructions: Another car is ahead in your lane: lead_m is the distance to it, lead_kmh its speed, and lead_closing_kmh the rate the gap is changing (positive is closing, negative is pulling away). Ghost mode is on, so contact cannot happen - the car ahead is information about the road and the pace, not a hazard. What should the driver do?

criteria.throttle: Hold the pace and follow it
criteria.brake: Drop back and give it room
criteria.hold: Lift off and let the gap settle
criteria.steer_left: Move to the left of it
criteria.steer_right: Move to the right of it

confidence.instructions: How sure are you of that?

recovery.blocked.when: verdict is blocked or stalled, or the rules are mid-manoeuvre

action.instructions: The car cannot make progress where it is pointing: the situation field says what it is against, and moved_m is how far it has actually travelled while the throttle was held. Reversing with the wheel turned is how a car leaves a wall; pushing forward again only presses it back into what it hit. Which way should the car go?

criteria.reverse_left: Back out with the wheel turned left: the way out is behind and to the left
criteria.reverse_right: Back out with the wheel turned right: the way out is behind and to the right
criteria.steer_left: Turn the wheel left and keep pushing forward
criteria.steer_right: Turn the wheel right and keep pushing forward
criteria.throttle: Hold the throttle down and wait for the car to come free
criteria.brake: Stop and give up on this direction

confidence.instructions: How sure are you of that way out?

action.instructions: A race is running. What should the car do?

risk.instructions: How much risk is acceptable here?

surface.loss.when: slip above 5 on a road, or a wheel on dirt or grass

action.instructions: Traction is being lost. What next?

criteria.brake: Ease off the throttle and brake

traffic.ghost.when: other cars are near and ghost mode is on

action.instructions: Other cars are close but ghost mode means contact cannot happen. What next?

criteria.throttle: Ignore them and keep the pace
